name: lazypowers
description: Instruction-only Product chat with a manual specification queue and one-way Superpowers task dispatch

interface.longDescription: Save product specifications to a small manual queue, create and name one visible Superpowers task chat on command, then stop monitoring it. The task chat owns implementation, Git, retries, permissions, deployment, and final reporting.
capabilities: One visible Superpowers task chat per dispatch
defaultPrompt: Use $lazypowers:product to draft a specification, place it in the manual queue, and dispatch it to a separate Superpowers task chat.
